data.gender_notes: Furayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-r-y', meaning 'to be free, liberated, or escape'. In the Quran, Furayah is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for her generosity and charitable deeds. The name Furayah carries the meaning “Liberated, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Furayah usually hope their child will grow to embody liberated, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furayah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
